moments.title: Champions League kicks off tonight for Man Utd
moments.blurb: Manchester United are back in Champions League action tonight, facing Azerbaijani newcomers Sabah FC in their opening group stage fixture.

angles.name: Match Hype
angles.copy: Tonight's the night! Manchester United kick off their Champions League campaign at home to Sabah FC. Who's ready for some European football? #UCL

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: After a busy summer, Erik ten Hag's side begin their Champions League journey tonight. Can they get off to a winning start against Sabah FC? Live from 8 PM BST.

moments.title: UK teams begin Champions League campaign
moments.blurb: Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester City, and Aston Villa all kicked off their Champions League group stage fixtures this week, with mixed results across Matchday 1.

angles.name: Overview
angles.copy: The Champions League group stage is underway! UK teams have been in action this week, with Arsenal facing Napoli and Liverpool taking on Atlético Madrid. Catch up on all the results!

angles.name: Local Angle (e.g. London)
angles.copy: Arsenal were in Champions League action last night against Napoli. How did your team fare in their European opener? #COYG

moments.title: Premier League returns next weekend
moments.blurb: The Premier League resumes next weekend with Matchweek 5, featuring big clashes like Brentford vs Chelsea on Friday and Fulham vs Manchester United on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Preview
angles.copy: Get ready for more Premier League action! Matchweek 5 kicks off next Friday with Brentford vs Chelsea, followed by a packed Saturday and Sunday. What game are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: Big Game Focus
angles.copy: Manchester United travel to Fulham next Sunday for their Matchweek 5 fixture. After their Champions League opener, can they keep up the momentum?

moments.title: Championship action heating up for Welsh clubs
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship continues this weekend with Cardiff City playing Bolton Wanderers on Saturday and Swansea City hosting Burnley, while Wrexham face Southampton next Saturday.

angles.name: Welsh Derby Buzz
angles.copy: Big weekend for Welsh football fans! Cardiff City are at home to Bolton Wanderers this Saturday. Get behind your team! #CardiffCity

angles.name: Swansea & Wrexham
angles.copy: Swansea City host Burnley this Saturday in the Championship, while Wrexham have a home clash against Southampton next weekend. How will our Welsh teams perform?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch next Saturday
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing begins next Saturday, September 19th, with a new presenting team and celebrity line-up hitting the ballroom.

angles.name: Launch Hype
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing returns next Saturday for its big launch show. Who are you rooting for in this year's celebrity line-up?

angles.name: New Presenters
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are your new Strictly hosts! See them in action for the first time on the launch show, September 19th on BBC One.

moments.title: Niall Horan turns 33
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, known for One Direction and his successful solo career, celebrates his 33rd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the brilliant Niall Horan on September 13th! From One Direction to solo superstar, what's your favourite Niall track?

angles.name: Music Focus
angles.copy: It's Niall Horan's birthday on Sunday! His latest album 'Dinner Party' dropped in June and reached #1 on the UK Albums Chart. Still spinning it?

moments.title: Tom Hardy celebrates his 49th birthday
moments.blurb: Renowned British actor Tom Hardy, known for roles in 'Peaky Blinders', 'Inception', and 'Venom', turns 49 on September 15th.

angles.name: Birthday Greeting
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to the one and only Tom Hardy on Sunday! What's your favourite Tom Hardy film or TV series?

angles.name: Filmography
angles.copy: From Bane to Alfie Solomons, Tom Hardy has delivered some iconic performances. He turns 49 on Sunday – which of his characters stands out most for you?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54 next week
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher will celebrate his 54th birthday on September 21st.

angles.name: Birthday Buzz
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday next week on September 21st! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

angles.name: Iconic Frontman
angles.copy: Still got it! Liam Gallagher turns 54 next week. The iconic Oasis frontman continues to be a force in British music. What's your favourite Liam moment?

moments.title: Dolly Parton dominates UK Singles Chart posthumously
moments.blurb: The late music icon Dolly Parton has three songs in the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10 this week, including '9 To 5' at number 5, following her recent passing.

angles.name: Chart Tribute
angles.copy: An incredible tribute: Dolly Parton has three songs in the UK Top 10 this week, including '9 To 5' at #5. A true legend whose music lives on.

angles.name: Music Legacy
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's enduring legacy is clear with three tracks in the latest UK Singles Chart Top 10. Which of her classics is your favourite?

moments.title: Ella Langley tops the Official UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is the new number one on the Official UK Singles Chart this week, with Sienna Spiro and Hugel also in the Top 3.

angles.name: New Number 1
angles.copy: Big news on the Official UK Singles Chart! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is your new number one. What are you listening to this week?

angles.name: Chart Roundup
angles.copy: Beyond Ella Langley's #1, Sienna Spiro and Hugel ft. Imael Angel & Ultra Naté round out the Top 3 on this week's Official UK Singles Chart. Any surprises for you?

moments.title: New music Friday: Bloc Party, Ezra Collective, The Proclaimers drop albums
moments.blurb: This Friday sees a wave of new album releases, including 'The Anatomy Of A Brief Romance' from Bloc Party, 'Here Because Of Hope' by Ezra Collective, and 'You May Offend' from The Proclaimers.

angles.name: New Release Friday
angles.copy: It's New Music Friday tomorrow! What's top of your list to listen to? New albums from Bloc Party, Ezra Collective, and The Proclaimers are all dropping.

angles.name: Album Spotlight
angles.copy: Looking forward to hearing Bloc Party's 'The Anatomy Of A Brief Romance' tomorrow? Or perhaps Ezra Collective's 'Here Because Of Hope'? So many great new albums out!

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox signals start of astronomical autumn
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn, will occur on September 23rd at 01:05 BST, bringing nearly equal day and night across the UK.

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: Get ready for shorter days and longer nights! The Autumnal Equinox is coming on September 23rd, officially marking the start of astronomical autumn. Time for cosy nights in! #Autumn

angles.name: Weather Watch
angles.copy: While meteorological autumn started September 1st, the astronomical autumn officially begins with the equinox on September 23rd. What's your favourite thing about autumn in the UK?
